Title: Verify successful login redirects user to HomePagePath
Preconditions: User exists and has a configured HomePagePath
Steps: 1. Send POST request to /auth/validate with correct credentials. 2. Follow the redirect.
Expected Result: System authenticates user and successfully redirects to the dashboard or configured HomePagePath.

Title: Verify authenticated session persists across multiple API calls
Steps: 1. Login via /auth/validate. 2. Capture the session token/cookie. 3. Send GET request to /api/v2/pim/employees/count with the session token.
Expected Result: API returns 200 OK and employee count confirming the session is valid and persists.
